formats.key: swapTokensMultipleV3ERC20ToERC20(bytes32 _transactionId, string _integrator, string _referrer, address _receiver, uint256 _minAmountOut, (address callTo, address approveTo, address sendingAssetId, address receivingAssetId, uint256 fromAmount, bytes callData, bool requiresDeposit)[] _swapData)
effects: Pulls fromAmount of sendingAssetId from the signer for every step with requiresDeposit=true (_depositMultipleERC20Tokens).
Runs each whitelisted step; some steps are LI.FI or integrator fee collections that keep part of the input.
Sends the whole contract balance of the last step's receivingAssetId to _receiver and reverts if it is below _minAmountOut.
Returns leftover input tokens of a step to _receiver.
formats.shown: 'Swap for at least {min} {final token} to {receiver}', with every step's input amount and a separate list of true/false 'taken from wallet' flags.

findings.title: Multiple ERC20 swap: step inputs and 'taken from wallet' flags are two unpaired lists; the amount spent is not in the intent
findings.evidence: descriptor fields `_swapData.[].fromAmount` 'Swap Step Input' and `_swapData.[].requiresDeposit` 'Swap Step Taken From Wallet' (raw); GenericSwapFacetV3._depositMultipleERC20Tokens pulls only the steps with requiresDeposit. Case 0 shows '500000 XPR', '495000 XPR', then 'true', 'false'. interpolatedIntent 'Swap for at least {_minAmountOut} to {_receiver}' has no input amount.
findings.fix: Put `_swapData.[0].fromAmount` in the interpolatedIntent, or label the step as 'Step Input (pulled from wallet when flag true)'. Better: show the pulled amounts only, once the runners support filtering an array.

findings.title: Multiple ERC20 swap: the fee-collection step looks like an ordinary swap step
findings.evidence: Case 0: 5000 XPR goes from the Diamond to FeeCollector 0x3ef238c3… (callData eedd56e1 collectTokenFees, hidden as `_swapData.[].callData` never). The screen shows only '500000 XPR' and '495000 XPR'. The minimum received still bounds the outcome.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can flag which step is a fee. A label note such as 'some steps may be fees' would help.

cases.notes: 500000 XPR out (allowance spend merged into it) and 93.52B XEN in (≥ min shown). The reader could not tell why step 2 is 495000; that is the fee step.

effects: Pulls fromAmount of each requiresDeposit step's sendingAssetId from the signer.

findings.title: Multiple ERC20→native swap: step inputs and wallet flags are unpaired lists; the intent omits the amount spent

findings.fix: Add `_swapData.[0].fromAmount` to the intent and label the flags so they can be paired with the inputs.

findings.title: Multiple ERC20→native swap: the fee step is shown as a swap step
findings.evidence: Case 1: 0.7 TRX goes from the Diamond to FeeCollector 0x3ef238c3…; the screen shows 56 then 55.3 TRX with no explanation.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. A label hint could help.

findings.title: Symbiosis: the calldata that decides recipient, chain and output is not on the screen at all
findings.reason: On the MetaRouter path the facet sends the signer's deposited minAmount to metaRoute. Where it lands is decided by callTo/callData and the swap calldata, and the facet never checks them against _bridgeData. callData, firstSwapCalldata and secondSwapCalldata are not fields in the format. The screen admits the recipient and chain are 'not enforced; Symbiosis calldata decides' but never shows the real recipient, chain or output token. This matches the guide's critical example of inner router calls that decide the recipient while nothing shown states them. Case 33 is synthetic (no txHash), so there is no mined effect to check against.
